subject: MediSync — next steps: demo windows & attendee roster
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medisync.ai>, Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@brighthealth.org>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Quick recap + proposed demo windows (technical deep dive)

Hi Elena / Aaron —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we're all aligned before the deep dive:

- Primary goal: validate a production inference path for patient note summarization and clinical search (low latency SLOs, on-prem option).
- Key constraints: data residency in EU, SOC2 evidence, and predictable throughput during batch ingestion windows.
- Stakeholders you wanted: engineering lead (Aaron), procurement (Elena), and security/compliance owners for the later procurement step.

Next step: technical deep dive where we can show a short end-to-end flow (hosted + private options) and discuss telemetry/SLAs. Could you confirm which of the slots below work for your team? I intentionally listed times in CEST and BST to avoid confusion.

Option A — Thu 13 Aug 2026 — 09:00–10:00 CEST (08:00–09:00 BST) — 45m demo + 15m Q&A
Option B — Fri 14 Aug 2026 — 15:00–16:00 CEST (14:00–15:00 BST) — hands-on workshop style

Proposed Redwood attendees (so you know who'll be on the bridge):
- Markus Klein — Account Executive (platform overview + roadmap)
- Priyom Das — Demo/solutions engineer (live walkthrough and infra Qs)
- Kimberly Park — Customer success / onboarding (deployment cadence + runbook)

If neither works, tell me two windows that do and which timezone you prefer (CEST / BST / UTC). Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and attach a short SOW + network checklist for your infra team.

Attachments: MediSync_SOW_v1.pdf (draft scope), network_requirements.xlsx (short checklist)

Thanks —

Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +44 20 7946 03XX
[Attachment: MediSync_SOW_v1.pdf]

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the clear recap. Both Aaron and I are aligned on agenda and stakeholders. Friday the 14th at 15:00 CEST works better for our engineering lead (Aaron) because he's on clinic rounds earlier in the week.

One request: can we keep the session to 60 minutes but focus the first 20 on a high-level architecture (so our network/security reviewer can follow), then the remaining 40 on the live demo and operational questions?

Also cc'd our procurement address so they have visibility on the draft SOW.

Elena
VP of Operations | MediSync
elena.rossi@medisync.ai | +39 02 1234 5678

Markus / team —

Thanks — I'll take point on the demo technical runbook. For Friday 14 Aug at 15:00 CEST I suggest this micro-agenda:

- 0:00–0:20: Architecture and deployment modes (hosted vs private) — Priyom
- 0:20–0:40: Live inference walkthrough (prefix caching, KV cache sizing) — Priyom
- 0:40–0:55: Ops, SLAs, rollout patterns (canary/A-B fallback) — Kimberly
- 0:55–1:00: Next steps and procurement touchpoints — Markus

Also adding a short checklist request for your infra lead in the invite: public egress IP list, firewall rules, and expected peak QPS for the demo dataset. I'll attach the network_requirements.xlsx to the calendar invite.

I'll be on the Zoom bridge and will share a short replay of a 5-min inference trace to show latency.

Thanks —
